text:
maria.docs: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR that tries to consolidate function-calling examples and the structured-output guide. Want a quick sanity check before I add SDK snippets and link fixes.

eric_devex: sending the PR link? small ask: include one compact example showing function call + JSON schema + fallback parse. keep it minimal.

maria.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — draft. main changes: rewrite of /guides/structured-output, new examples in /examples/function-calling, and a note about guardrails.

nate_ml: skimmed — can we add a short sentence about model variance and nullable fields? people keep hitting parse errors when model omits optional keys.

maria.docs: yes — thinking of a "tolerant parsing" section with examples for optional keys + a fallback envelope.

alice-sdk: I can update the TypeScript snippet in examples to match SDK v1.8. It currently uses old invoke() signature. Will add a minimal helper: 
```ts
// safeParse helper
function safeParse(res: any) {
  try { return JSON.parse(res); } catch(e) { return { _raw: res }; }
}
```

leigh: also flag: link-checker-bot reported two broken anchors in the structured-output doc. They point to an old "schema-examples" id that was renamed.

link-checker-bot: Found 2 broken links in pull request 4123: /guides/structured-output#schema-examples -> 404; /examples/function-calling/#compact -> 404.

maria.docs: thanks — I'll fix anchors. thinking of renaming the compact example id to "compact-envelopes" to be explicit.

eric_devex: for guardrails section, add a tiny checklist: 1) require top-level "type" or "action" field, 2) include explicit nullable fields in schema, 3) minimal fallback parsing strategy. One-liners only.

nate_ml: add a note about tokenization impact on long structured fields — recommend truncating free-text fields before sending to models when you expect long content.

alice-sdk: PR plan: (1) fix TS snippet and publish a code diff, (2) add JS/py equivalents, (3) link to SDK changelog. Will put those commits in the branch.

maria.docs: action items: 
- @alice-sdk update SDK snippets (TS/JS/Py) — thanks.
- @eric_devex add guardrail checklist bullets.
- @nate_ml add a one-paragraph model-behavior note.
- I will fix anchors and add tolerant parsing mini-section with example.

leigh: I'll review once alice pushes snippets. Quick ask: keep example sizes < 20 lines so they fit the inline docs.

maria.docs: agreed. Also plan to add a single end-to-end compact example: prompt -> function call -> model returns envelope -> safeParse fallback. Example will be ~14 lines.

alice-sdk: pushing snippet PR in ~30m. Leaving TODO comments in doc for Nate and Eric to fill.

link-checker-bot: New commit pushed to branch. Rechecking links... Remaining broken: /examples/function-calling/#compact -> now resolves to /examples/function-calling/#compact-envelopes. All good.

maria.docs: awesome. Thom (if you see this) — want to volunteer as reviewer for the final PR? need someone to sanity-check wording for platform guarantees.

leigh: happy to review final wording.

maria.docs: thanks all — I'll merge after snippets + guardrail bullets land and CI passes. Will post final changelog line in #release-notes when merged. :tada:
